messages:
jamie (support): forwarding a customer ticket — they see a burst of 429s and wrong-dimension embeddings after a deploy. customer says 'batching used to be fine, now vectors are 1536 instead of 768 and our downstream fails'.

eve (customer): here is the exact curl we used, getting 200s but shape mismatch downstream. we only changed region (us-east -> eu-west) in config last week.

```
curl -sS -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-1-small","input":["foo","bar"],"batch_size":8}'
```

jamie (support): attached customer logs — they log the vector len coming back as 1536. also saw a mix of 429 (capacity) and 200 but with unexpected dims. pasted logs below.

```
2026-02-25T14:03:22Z INFO req_id=abc123 endpoint=/v1/embeddings model=text-embedding-1-small region=eu-west-1 latency_ms=120
2026-02-25T14:03:22Z WARN req_id=abc123 vector_len=1536 downstream=fail
2026-02-25T14:03:24Z ERROR req_id=abc125 429 TooManyRequests pool=embeddings-us-east-1 active=98% spillover=true
```

jamie (support): quick notes: customer expects 768 dims (text-embedding-1-small), but we delivered 1536 dims (looks like a larger model). They've also reported higher latency and sporadic 429s after switching region in their config.

Priya (SRE): thanks, pinging infra — @Diego can you check routing policy for that tenant? sounds like regional routing gave them eu-west model variants or fallback to text-embedding-3-large due to capacity. also, capacity-bot posted alerts around same time.

capacity-bot: [alert] 2026-02-25T14:02:50Z embeddings-us-east-1 GPU pool at 94% (spillover routing active). Canary autoscaler scaled +1 at 14:05:10Z.

Diego (Infra): investigating. initial look: tenant routing tag for that org got a new preference 'prefer-eu' from a recent rollout, but their API key is bound to a us-east capacity commitment — mismatch. When us-east pool hit 90% we route to nearest compatible region; because of a model-variant mismatch mapping bug, the mapping chose the large variant in eu-west (1536 dims) instead of the small variant.

Priya (SRE): that explains dim mismatch + 429s (spillover). what's the repro? can we reproduce quickly and provide safe mitigation for the customer?

jamie (support): customer provided repro above. also they can share a sample API key for testing (we have consent).

Diego (Infra): repro steps I used:
1) set routing override header: `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1`
2) send batching payload with `model=text-embedding-1-small` and batch_size=8
3) observe 200 responses with vector length 1536 when eu-west pool routes to text-embedding-3-large fallback

shell snippet I used:
```
export KEY=sk-test-customer
curl -sS -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-1-small","input":["a","b","c"],"batch_size":8}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

Diego (Infra): temporary mitigation: patching routing mapping to prefer exact model-name matches instead of picking any compatible family variant. rolling to canary in eu-west now. also increasing us-east embed pool target by +2 nodes to reduce spillover.

Priya (SRE): file a rollback-safe fix, and add a regression test that asserts model name -> dims mapping. also add an alert for 'model_variant_mismatch' when returned vector dims != expected dims for requested model.

jamie (support): relaying mitigations to customer — asking them to try again with region header removed (let the platform pick) and to set `batch_size=1` for now if they need deterministic behavior while we stabilize.

eve (customer): ok will try now. sending request with no region override and batch_size=1.

eve (customer): results: vectors are now 768 and no 429s in the next minute. latency also improved. thanks.

jamie (support): great. recording root cause: routing tag + variant-mapping bug + spillover due to transient us-east load. action items: (1) Diego will finish canary and promote mapping fix; (2) Priya to create regression & alert; (3) Support to follow up with customer post-48h and offer a temporary credit if any invoice spikes from retries.

Diego (Infra): canary patch promoting now — config diff applied:
```
- model_variant_select: nearest_compatible
+ model_variant_select: exact_name_then_compatible
```

Diego (Infra): also added quick metric: `return.vector_dim != expected_dim` emits a 1m alert to oncall.

qa (support): please add an automated e2e that sends a `text-embedding-1-small` request and asserts returned dims == 768 across regions (eu-west, us-east). I'll own the test case.

Priya (SRE): tagging incident: INC-2026-0454. owners Diego + Priya. ETA for full rollout and postmortem: 48 hours.

jamie (support): I'll update the customer thread with the incident link and next steps. thanks all :thumbsup:

eve (customer): thanks everyone for the fast fix. we'll keep an eye and report if anything else shows up.

jamie (support): closing loop here. follow-ups: billing review, 48h check-in, add stronger doc note about region header and model name binding.
